test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word. **
solution:
The correct answer is** "Accelarate".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Option 2, "Accelarate" is spelled incorrectly. The correct **spelling **of this word is **"Accelerate."**

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Here are the key points to consider:**

 
 
• Option 1,** 'Calibrate',** is spelled **correctly. **This word means **'to adjust or fine-tune a machine or instrument so it works correctly or according to certain measurements.'**
 
• Option 3, **'Proliferate'**, is spelled **correctly. **This word means **'increase rapidly in number; multiply.'**
 
• Option 4,** 'Insinuate',** is also spelled **correctly. **This word is used when one wants to express **'suggest or hint (something bad) in an indirect and unpleasant way.'**
